summary: List company root folder children bulk-action blocking summary
description:
Counts how many rows block a bulk action, over exactly the rows the company root folder children endpoint returns across all of its pages for the same filters. Intended for a "select all" in the UI, where the client has not loaded every row and cannot check them itself.
Accepts the same `filters[...]` parameters as that endpoint, and takes no `include_descendants`, `sort`, `view`, `exclude_folders`, `exclude_files` or pagination. With no filters it counts the root folder's direct children; with any filter it counts the whole company Documents tool, matching the rows the listing returns with `include_descendants=true`. Rows the user cannot see are not counted.

parameters.name: unselected_ids[]
parameters.description: Ids to exclude from the counts, for a "select all" the user has since narrowed by deselecting individual rows. Deselecting a folder does not exclude its descendants. Non-integer values return 400.

data.description: Counts of rows that block a bulk action, taken over the same rows the matching folder children listing returns across all of its pages. A row can count toward more than one counter.

read_only.description: Rows that are read-only, such as Schedules content.

checked_out.description: File rows whose checkout has not yet expired. Folders never count, and an expired checkout does not count.

in_recycle_bin.description: Rows that cannot be recycled because they are read-only or already in the recycle bin.

400.description: Invalid filter parameter — unknown filter key, invalid filter value, malformed `filters`, or a non-integer `unselected_ids`.
